title: tetradium glabrifolium var. glaucum
intro: Tetradium glabrifolium var. glaucum, commonly known as 'White Flower', is a plant species belonging to the Rutaceae family. It is valued for its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Tetradium glabrifolium var. glaucum include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce fever, and alleviate pain, as well as its potential in treating respiratory and cardiovascular conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
